subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: Should recovery for stuck staged publish attempts be operator-controlled worker/drain/retry handling, a temporary production flag rollback, or a publisher-facing bypass like the linked PR?
rationale: The user-visible blocker is urgent, but the proposed API bypass changes who can skip prepublication TruffleHog and ClawScan checks, and the production logs/table needed to identify the safest fix are maintainer-only.

options.title: Prefer operator-controlled recovery
options.body: Inspect production logs and publishAttempts, drain or retry stuck attempts, and add a guarded operator-only recovery path if code is needed while keeping the default security gate intact.

options.title: Temporarily disable staging
options.body: Turn off staged prepublication in production long enough to unblock trusted republish attempts, then re-enable it after the worker cause is fixed.

options.title: Accept publisher-facing bypass
options.body: Land the linked bypass direction with explicit maintainer security approval and clear documentation of when publishers may skip staging.

recommendation.title: Prefer operator-controlled recovery
recommendation.body: Inspect production logs and publishAttempts, drain or retry stuck attempts, and add a guarded operator-only recovery path if code is needed while keeping the default security gate intact.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen authored the staged publish and worker commits and is the strongest code-history owner for the security/availability tradeoff.
